sources.BLS: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation and Consumer Price Index release archives and schedules (public domain).
sources.FRB: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, FOMC meeting calendars (public domain).

times: NFP and CPI 08:30 America/New_York; FOMC statement interval 12:30-14:15 America/New_York on the last day of a scheduled meeting

exceptions.2020: FOMC 7: the March 17-18 meeting was cancelled (Board's 2020 calendar); the unscheduled March 2 and March 15 meetings were not known in advance and are not events.
exceptions.2025: NFP 11 and CPI 11: the October 2025 Employment Situation was not published and the October 2025 CPI was cancelled because of the 2025 lapse in appropriations (BLS archive and 2025 revised release dates); the September 2025 reports came out on Oct 24 (CPI) and Nov 20 (NFP).
